name: Deployment Diagram — Kubernetes System
description: Deployment Diagram describes how software artifacts are deployed onto Kubernetes nodes, along with the communication paths and protocols between them.
purpose: Design cloud-native infrastructure architecture on Kubernetes.
bestFor: Describing load balancer, database, message broker
useCases: Identify nodes: Kubernetes Cluster, Worker Node, Pod
Describe artifacts: Docker image, ConfigMap, Secret
Add communication paths: HTTPS, gRPC, JDBC
Represent infrastructure: Nginx Ingress, Redis, PostgreSQL
requirements: REQ-001: Application is packaged as Docker image
REQ-002: Frontend and Backend deployed separately on 2 Pods
REQ-003: Nginx Ingress acts as load balancer and TLS termination
REQ-004: Backend connects to PostgreSQL via JDBC
REQ-005: Redis used for session cache
